correctness.rationale: Under exact tests T_l and single-agent S5, atomic profiles c and class support S give full formula equivalence iff pairs (S,c) agree: atoms recover c, modal exact tests recover S; box induction establishes converse. A block with support size s has EGF (e^z-1)^s, arbitrary set of such blocks exp((e^z-1)^s), and marking distinct realized supports yields product over s of [1+u^s(exp((e^z-1)^s)-1)]^{binom(m,s)}. Type families require sum|S|<=n; maximum M=m2^{m-1}. Missing singleton support coefficient ratio by saddle at W(n)/m gives exp(1-(n/W(n))^{1/m}) and for m=2 a nonvanishing saddle-displacement correction exp(-1/8). Higher supports and multi-singleton absences negligible at fixed m. Independent direct n<=5 enumerators m=2,3 matched and numerical m=2 coefficient ratios at n50,100,200,350 approached predicted prefactor; this is a sanity check, not proof of asymptotic.
